natural_utterances: Покажи по каждому товару, проданному вчера на Озоне, артикул, количество и фактическую цену, которую заплатил покупатель с учётом скидки Озона.
По какой цене покупатели купили каждый товар вчера на Озоне с учётом скидки Озона?

source.pagination: Continue using last_id until empty; reject repeated cursor and duplicate accrual/product rows

ambiguous_sale_date_policy: Preserve requested period and store; clarify order date vs accrual date vs actual buyout event before returning figures as sold yesterday.

projection.quantity_mode: Live-qualified quantities 1 and 2. sale_price is a customer LINE amount; divide by quantity for the line-average price. Do not multiply this line amount by quantity again. Individual receipt prices within a multi-unit line are not separately observed.
projection.money: Decimal from source amount strings; sum customer sale_price line amounts and quantities. Keep seller_price per unit and sale_amount seller line amount separate.
projection.names: Optional product metadata joined by exact SKU; never used for price computation
